office_does: A State Senator writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets, and confirms the governor's appointees.
race_blurb: Republican Shelly Short, the Senate Republican Floor Leader and a legislator since 2009, faces independent Ronald McCoy, a former Chewelah mayor and Navy veteran. Short took 57.9% and McCoy 27.7% in the primary.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Republican senator and Senate Republican Floor Leader, in the Legislature since 2009, focused on agriculture, natural resources, wildfire and opposing state taxes and regulation.
highlights: Voted against the 2026 tax on income over $1 million (ESSB 6346) [S5]
Voted against the 2025 capital-gains/estate and B&O tax increases [S6]
Voted against ESHB 1296, the 2025 changes to the parental-rights list [S8]
Calls wildfire risk and homeowner insurance her top priority [S3]

taxes.basis: Voted Nay on ESSB 6346, SB 5813 and HB 2081 and pledges to stand against 'endless taxes'.

spending.basis: Opposes 'unchecked spending' and voted against the 2025-27 operating budget; no specific audit or cut proposals found.

local-control.basis: Campaigns on fighting 'burdensome agency rules' and battling state government when it stands in the way of local prosperity.

parental-rights.basis: Voted against ESHB 1296, which modified and narrowed parts of the I-2081 parental-rights list; no campaign statement on the topic.

experience.basis: In the Legislature since 2009, senator since 2017 and Republican Floor Leader.

candidates.summary: Independent former Chewelah mayor and retired Navy petty officer, running on rural healthcare, small-business tax relief and independence from party and lobbyists.
highlights: Former Chewelah mayor (1998-2002) and city councilmember [S1][S3]
Focuses on rural healthcare access for older and disabled residents [S3]
Names tax burdens on small businesses and 'protect taxpayers' as priorities [S1][S2]
Says the district was not built by lobbyists and special interests [S1]

taxes.basis: Names small-business and household tax burdens as a concern and 'protect taxpayers' as a goal, without a specific tax proposal.

reform.basis: Runs as an independent against lobbyists, special interests and 'big money'.

experience.basis: Former small-city mayor and councilmember with no state-level office, running as a change candidate against an 18-year legislator.
